description: Source code for connection security management in a TR-069 CWMP server, including connection timestamp tracking and connection limit enforcement.

methods.name: cwmp_server_initConnectionTimestampList
methods.description: Initializes the linked list for storing connection timestamps.

methods.name: cwmp_server_maxConnectionsAdd
methods.description: Adds a new timestamp to the connection list when a connection is made.

methods.name: cwmp_server_maxConnectionsReached
methods.description: Checks if the maximum number of connections has been reached based on timestamps and configuration parameters.

methods.name: cwmp_server_maxConnectionsCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the connection timestamp list.
